title: Transfer ticket (v1)
$comment: Self-contained. Authorizes a RESUMABLE, VERIFIED bulk transfer of one weight segment (or a chunk sub-range of it) to one device. priority_class is const bulk_weight_background: a weight transfer NEVER outranks activation/result/control traffic (that ordering is enforced on the wire by transport_frame). resumable_from_verified_offset + resume_partial_sha256 are what let RECEIVING resume without trusting a byte-length offset: a resume re-hashes the on-disk prefix and matches it against resume_partial_sha256 before appending. chunk_range must lie inside the segment's chunk list (semantic check). deadline_us is nullable (background weights usually have none).

idempotency_key.description: a retried ticket with the same key is a no-op, never a double-apply

expected_sha256.description: content digest of the full segment; the VERIFYING target

resume_partial_sha256.description: SHA-256 of bytes [0, resumable_from_verified_offset); null on a fresh transfer

credits_bytes.description: flow-control byte credit granted to this ticket
